# Copilot instructions for Upgradeables

Read `START_HERE.md` first and choose the task, Skill-building, or contribution
route. When asked to use the library, complete the requested work rather than
editing the registry or only explaining it.

When asked to build a Skill, follow `MODEL_CONSUMPTION_GUIDE.md` and return a
keep/drop selection table, a complete `SKILL.md` based on
`templates/SKILL_IMPLEMENTATION_TEMPLATE.md`, host adaptation notes, and
behavioral/composition tests.

When contributing, distinguish a community Skill from a new canonical
Upgradeable and follow `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Preserve Skill/Gene/Core/Upgradeable
distinctions, registry generations, provenance, and unresolved gaps. Prefer
composition to duplicate primitives. Run every validator listed in `README.md`
after repository edits.
